titles.ja: クラスの遠足を計画する

objectives_zh_TW: 整合比較級、最高級和條件限制比較出遊地點。
整合未來意圖及已安排活動，寫出出遊計畫。
運用本季句型閱讀、選擇及說明計畫的理由。
episodes.parent_tip_zh_TW: 複習時先列比較資料，再寫選擇和已約定的細節；用本季句型完成短文，不需硬塞全部形式。

practice.prompt_en: Write four sentences planning a class outing. Compare places, state your choice, and give an agreed meeting arrangement.
practice.prompt_zh_TW: 寫四句規劃班遊：比較地點、說明選擇，再提供已約好的見面安排。
practice.sample_answer_en: The park is cheaper than the pool, but the museum is the most interesting place. Our class chooses the museum for Friday. We are meeting at school at nine in the morning. We are going to bring sandwiches for lunch.
practice.reading_en: Our class discussed three places yesterday. The park was cheaper than the pool, but the museum was the most interesting. We chose the museum. We are meeting at school at nine on Friday, and our bus tickets are ready. We are going to bring sandwiches because the cafe is too expensive.
